reports.title: Audit of Lighter's zkLighter Circuits
reports.description: zkSecurity review of the original gnark-based zkLighter main and exit-hatch circuits and the GKR-based MiMC hash, performed on extracted code shared in an unnamed private repository with no commit or file paths stated. The audited gnark circuits were later replaced by the Plonky2 prover and were never published, so no accessible repository path or revision can be identified.

The report states no commit; the audited revision is taken from the diff base named in the follow-up Block and Delta report.

reports.title: Audit of Lighter's Exit Hatch
reports.description: zkSecurity review of the desert exit (escape hatch) Plonky2 circuits in desertexit/circuits at commit b99c425 of lighter-prover, together with its witness generator and minor changes to the main transaction circuits. Fixes for the High and Medium findings are stated as commit f6818da on the spot branch.

versions.coverage: Core exit-claim validation and TAV computation. Finding #00 (High, negative TAV bypass); #02 (Low) overflow scenarios acknowledged. Commit b99c425 is stated by the report and is not served by the public repository.
Remediation of #00 (TAV clamping). Fix commit f6818da (abbreviated, spot branch) as stated by the report; not served by the public repository.
Proof wrapping layer for recursive verification. Commit b99c425 is stated by the report and is not served by the public repository.
Account pubdata structures. Finding #01 (Medium, unauthenticated master_account_index). Commit b99c425 is stated by the report and is not served by the public repository.
Remediation of #01 (exit commitment uses authenticated l1_address). Fix commit f6818da (abbreviated, spot branch) as stated by the report; not served by the public repository.
Market pubdata structures. Finding #02 (Low) overflow scenarios acknowledged. Commit b99c425 is stated by the report and is not served by the public repository.
Blob data deserialization. Commit b99c425 is stated by the report and is not served by the public repository.
Witness generator reviewed alongside the circuit; findings #02 (Low) and #03 (Informational) reference it. Commit b99c425 is stated by the report and is not served by the public repository.
Remediation of #03 (unsigned limb assembly). Fix commit f6818da (abbreviated, spot branch) as stated by the report; not served by the public repository.

Minor changes to the main transaction circuits only: zero quote calculation in liquidation and deleverage, exclusion of frozen markets from margin requirements, delta circuit sign packing, removal of the deleverager health check, frozen public pool transfer restrictions, zero public key, the try_sub_biguint refactor and the quote_multiplier migration to the public market hash. Commit b99c425 is stated by the report and is not served by the public repository.
